description: This file contains unit tests for the AbstractIndexer class in the SuiteCRM search indexing system. It defines a test class 'AbstractIndexerTest' with multiple test methods that verify the behavior of the AbstractIndexer, including its construction, getters and setters, module addition, name retrieval, and logger setup. The tests use PHPUnit and Mockery frameworks to mock dependencies and validate expected behaviors.

classes.name: AbstractIndexerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AbstractIndexer class in the SuiteCRM search indexing component.

methods.name: testConstruct
methods.description: Verifies that the indexer mock object is an instance of AbstractIndexer after construction.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Tests the getters and setters of the AbstractIndexer, including setting differential indexing flag, documentifier, and modules, as well as handling null input.

methods.name: testAddModulesToIndex
methods.description: Checks that modules can be added correctly to the indexer and handles invalid input appropriately.

methods.name: testGetDocumentifierName
methods.description: Verifies that the documentifier name retrieval returns correct class names for different documentifier instances.

methods.name: testGetIndexerName
methods.description: Validates that getIndexerName returns the mocked name of the indexer.

methods.name: testLogger
methods.description: Ensures that calling setupLogger initializes a Monolog Logger instance.
